#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bench every model in models/ and append one summary line per run to
# results.tsv. Safe to re-run: finished models are skipped by name.

set -euo pipefail

MODELS_DIR="${1:-models}"
OUT="results.tsv"
TIMEOUT=900

if [[ ! -d "$MODELS_DIR" ]]; then
    echo "no such directory: $MODELS_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# one header, written once
if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
    printf 'model\ttok_s\ttpot_ms\tttft_ms\n' > "$OUT"
fi

for gguf in "$MODELS_DIR"/*.gguf; do
    name=$(basename "$gguf" .gguf)
    if grep -q "^$name$(printf '\t')" "$OUT"; then
        echo "skip $name (already measured)"
        continue
    fi
    echo "measuring $name"
    row=$(timeout "$TIMEOUT" toktape record --model "$gguf" --json |
        jq -r '[.summary.id, .summary.tokens_per_second, .summary.tpot_ms] | @tsv')
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$row" >> "$OUT"
done

count=$(wc -l < "$OUT")
echo "done: $((count - 1)) runs recorded in $OUT"
